text: maybe there is some sense in doing this: make is effectively an infinite space canvas, and that will let us let a user put several images down anywhere, and that way they can make one texture without having to try and stuff a bunch of shit on one image alone
resolution: The UV panel now owns a persistent multi-image workspace with immutable content-addressed PNG sources, native-resolution signed placement, visibility and stacking controls, and an explicit progress-reporting Compile action. Compile validates sources, composites the smallest visible transparent union without resampling, translates local UVs by the inverse atlas-origin change, and keeps every original layer editable so another image can be added and recompiled later.
